_note: Fighters whose season source and our fighter roster use names that no spelling rule connects. Everything the shared matcher can derive — a shortened given name, an initial written two ways, a suffix, a reversed family-name order, an extra surname — lives in scripts/tuf/lib/names.mjs and is applied automatically. This file is only for identities that must be asserted, and each one records what it was checked against so the assertion can be argued with rather than taken on trust.
_rule: An entry is added only when the same bout, on the same card and date, is confirmed in our own ufc_bouts under the other name. A name that merely looks similar does not belong here.
